verdict.rationale: Twenty supports unlimited custom objects, custom fields (including select/stage-like fields), and kanban views grouped by stage, which in principle lets ops build separate pipeline objects with distinct stage sets for different products or motions (twenty-docs-1, twenty-docs-2, twenty-docs-30, twenty-docs-34). However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'multiple pipelines' feature, named stage-type fields, or per-pipeline stage configuration UI — the capability is inferred from generic object/field/view flexibility rather than a purpose-built pipeline-management feature. Missing for 10: explicit multi-pipeline/stage-set documentation, named 'pipeline' object type or stage field type, and any hands-on/community confirmation that separate pipelines with distinct stages work well in practice.
